family.reason: Private radio and television broadcasters, television and multimedia section.

notes.text: CCNL Radiotelevisivo 2026 signed 08/01/2026 in Roma. Employer: Confindustria Radio Televisioni (pres. Antonio Marano) and ANICA (pres. Alessandro Usai). Unions: SLC-CGIL (Sindacato Lavoratori della Comunicazione), FISTEL-CISL (Federazione Informazioni Spettacolo e Telecomunicazioni), UIL-COM (UIL Comunicazione). Signatories sourced from Art. 1, page 7 of CCNL PDF.
Source anchor: https://www.confindustriaradiotv.it/ is the employer association homepage; a direct PDF permalink was not published. PDF read locally as ccnl_radiotv_2026.pdf (81 MB, read 2026-09-12).
SPLIT model: paga base (minimo tabellare, Art. 43) + contingenza congelata al 1° novembre 1991 (Allegato A). EDR not present in 2026 CCNL.

DUAL-SECTOR contract: Settore Televisivo Multimediale (9 livelli) and Settore Radiofonico (6 livelli) modelled in two separate files because the engine's monotonicity validator (higher order >= higher salary at every tranche date) rejects a merged 15-level file: at 01/01/2026 Radio L2 (868.41) > TV L1 (835.62) and Radio L6 (1632.31) > TV L5 (1571.00), inverting the relative ordering set at the CCNL base date.

TV sector has three new tranches: 01/01/2026, 01/06/2027, 01/01/2028. Radio sector has only two: 01/01/2026, 01/06/2027 (no 01/01/2028 tranche). The pre-2026 CCNL column values (from the 2022 contract) are not modelled.

Hourly divisor 173 sourced from Art. 43. Verified on levels 3, 5, 7: none of the three back-calculations from the published hourly rate yield a conglobated total — values are paga base only, confirming the split model.
Apprenticeship (Art. 27): professionalizzante, percentage type. TV L3 max 24 months; TV L4-L6 max 48-60 months (same % schedule). Levels L7-L9 not accessible via apprenticeship per Art. 27.
INPS rates reuse existing 2026-industria.json (tax_sector=industria). No bilateral fund substitution for broadcasting sector identified; standard Confindustria INPS rates apply.

limitation.remediation: Confirm the 2026 INPS rates of the broadcasters (industria, CIGO vs FIS by size) against the INPS circular, and route the roles insured in the ex-ENPALS FPLS to that regime.

notes.text: Apprenticeship open tail: Art. 27 sets 24-month max for L3 (breve track). The final period {18, null, 0.90} cannot be closed to {18, 24, 0.90} because the engine schema requires the last apprenticeship period to be open-ended (validate_open_sequence). A query past month 24 is outside the contract duration and should not arise in normal use.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The minimi tabellari of the Settore Televisivo Multimediale against the tables of the renewal published by Confindustria Radio Televisioni.
findings: The minimi of the 9 levels from 2026-01-01 to 2028-01-01 (PDF p. 1, text layer; the same tables are in the consolidated CCNL 2026, PDF pp. 74-75) match the file and move from assumed to verified.
The ruleset names this source, published by Confindustria Radio Televisioni, the employer signatory: source_type contracting_party instead of estimated.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 45 - Tredicesima mensilità (p. 76): "Nel caso di inizio del rapporto durante il corso dell’anno, il lavoratore avrà diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell'ammontare della tredicesima mensilità per quanti sono i mesi di servizio prestati nell’Azienda. Le frazioni di mese superiori a 15 giorni saranno da considerare mese intero.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

reviews.scope: The notice clause (Art. 64 - Preavviso di licenziamento e dimissioni, p. 86).
findings: Notice bands checked against the PDF by a separate session (delegated search and independent verification): work_rules.notice.

reviews.scope: Parental leave by the hour (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001): the clause located in the cited file by sha256.
Hourly base, night, holiday and shift supplements, travel allowance: quotes located in the cited files by sha256, values read against the quotes.
findings: Left out: bands[0:night]: quote skipped; bands[1:holiday]: quote skipped; bands[2:holiday_compensatory_rest]: quote skipped; bands[3:sunday]: quote skipped; bands[4:night_holiday]: quote skipped; bands[5:day_shift]: quote skipped; bands[6:night_shift]: quote skipped.

location.section: Art. 64 - Preavviso di licenziamento e dimissioni
location.quote:
9° - 8° livello 180 giorni di calendario
7° - 6° - 5° livello 90 giorni di calendario
4° livello 60 giorni di calendario
3° livello 45 giorni di calendario
2° - 1° livello 21 giorni di calendario
I termini di preavviso di cui sopra hanno inizio dal 1° o dal 16° giorno di ciascun mese.

source_document.title: CCNL per i dipendenti di imprese radiotelevisive, multimediali e multipiattaforma (19 dicembre 2017)

location.section: Art. 59 Tutela della maternità e della paternità
location.quote: Ai sensi del D.Lgs.. 15 giugno 2015, n. 80 nel caso in cui il congedo parentale venga richiesto in modalità di fruizione oraria lo stesso sarà riconosciuto in gruppi minimi di 4 ore giornaliere con termine di preavviso pari a 5 giorni lavorativi. L’azienda e la RSU potranno definire modalità e condizioni per la fruizione dei congedi parentali su base oraria in misura inferiore a quelli previsti dalle norme di legge, in relazione alle esigenze organizzative e produttive.

provenance.transformation: This radiotelevision agreement covers television workers too. Its four-hour minimum block is a contractual rule different from the statutory half-average-day criterion, but does not define the number of hours equivalent to a whole day; no part-time scaling is specified. The verified 2017 agreement is the earliest documented occurrence.

location.section: Art. 58 Trasferta
location.quote: Al lavoratore in missione o trasferta l’Azienda corrisponderà: a) il rimborso delle spese effettive sostenute per il viaggio con i normali mezzi di trasporto; b) il rimborso delle spese documentate di vitto e di alloggio, nei limiti della normalità, quando la durata del servizio obblighi il lavoratore ad incontrare tali spese; c) il rimborso delle altre eventuali spese vive necessarie, documentate, per l’espletamento della missione.

provenance.transformation: The CCNL pays no daily travel allowance: the trasferta is refunded at documented cost
